SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS d,
       COUNT(*) AS lines,
       SUM(qty) AS qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sku_scanned IS NULL OR sku_scanned <> 'ATTA-WW-5KG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_sku_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN gtin_scanned IS DISTINCT FROM '2900001001014' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_gtin_lines
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND (sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR gtin_scanned = '2900001001014')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS d,
       COUNT(*) AS all_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS atta_qty
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT sku, date, units_sold FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE units_sold = 0 ORDER BY sku, date;
SELECT * FROM store.store_orders WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY created_ts;

SELECT ds.sku, ds.date, ds.units_sold,
       (SELECT string_agg(sa.status, ',') FROM store.shelf_audits sa
         WHERE sa.sku=ds.sku AND sa.audit_ts::date=ds.date) AS audit_status
FROM store.daily_sales ds
WHERE ds.units_sold=0
ORDER BY ds.sku, ds.date;

SELECT ds.sku, ds.date, ds.units_sold,
       (SELECT string_agg(sa.status, ',') FROM store.shelf_audits sa
         WHERE sa.sku=ds.sku AND sa.audit_ts::date=ds.date) AS audit_status
FROM store.daily_sales ds
WHERE ds.units_sold=0 AND ds.sku <> 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ds.sku, ds.date;
SELECT * FROM warehouse.stock_adjustments WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY adjusted_ts;

WITH days AS (
  SELECT generate_series('2026-06-01'::date, '2026-06-28'::date, '1 day')::date AS d
),
sales AS (
  SELECT bill_ts::date AS d, SUM(qty) AS units
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE (sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR gtin_scanned = '2900001001014')
    AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
rec AS (
  SELECT received_ts::date AS d, COUNT(*) AS grns
  FROM store.goods_receipts
  WHERE asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND received_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND received_ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
aud AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS d, string_agg(status, ',') AS status
  FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' GROUP BY 1
),
f AS (
  SELECT date AS d, forecast_units_per_day FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
)
SELECT days.d,
       COALESCE(sales.units,0) AS sold_packs,
       COALESCE(rec.grns,0) AS goods_receipts,
       aud.status AS audit_status,
       f.forecast_units_per_day AS forecast_demand,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(sales.units,0) > 0 THEN 'on shelf (a sale proves the pack was there)'
            WHEN aud.status = 'empty' THEN 'empty (shelf audit)'
            WHEN COALESCE(rec.grns,0) = 0 THEN 'empty (no sale, no receipt; 06-26 count found 0 on shelf)'
            ELSE 'unknown' END AS shelf_state
FROM days
LEFT JOIN sales USING (d)
LEFT JOIN rec USING (d)
LEFT JOIN aud USING (d)
LEFT JOIN f USING (d)
ORDER BY days.d;
